message.content: According to the conversation, Li Hua expressed enthusiasm about diving back into Call of Duty: Warzone when the updates roll out. Specifically, during a discussion about upcoming updates, Li Hua stated, "Absolutely! I'm always up for something new in the game. I love exploring fresh content and teaming up with friends! Let’s hop on together when the updates drop!" This indicates that Li Hua plans to continue playing Warzone after the scheduled updates.
